name: Address Decoupled Commerce
description: Provides the decoupled Commerce functionality for the address module.
project_description: Submodule of Address Decoupled. Provides a Commerce-aware variant of the store supported-countries REST resource: instead of taking a store id in the path, it resolves the current Commerce store via commerce_store.current_store and returns that store's shipping and billing supported countries as full country objects. Requires the parent address_decoupled module plus Commerce (commerce, commerce_store). It overrides/re-registers the rest resource plugin id address_decoupled_store_supported_countries with the canonical path /address-decoupled/api/store/supported-countries (no {store} argument).
